title: fix: preserve units of zero lengths in values that also accept numbers
author: giuliowaitforitdavide (opened by devongovett)
summary: Keeps the unit on zero lengths where the grammar also accepts <number> (line-height, tab-size, border-image-outset/width, mask-border-*, @property initial-value with <number>/<integer>), so animations to/from 0px don't become discrete. The bug is real on master, but the maintainer already judged (review calibration log) that the fix is in the wrong place: hand-written ToCss impls are copy-pasted into LengthOrNumber, BorderImageSideWidth and LineHeight instead of being solved once in a shared type or the ToCss derive. That feedback has not been posted on the PR yet.
evidence: Master (base-4a1b083 CLI): `.a{line-height:0px;border-image-outset:0 0px;tab-size:0px}` -> `.a{tab-size:0;border-image-outset:0 0;line-height:0}` (unit dropped). target/triage/calibration/review-pr.md row #1416: maintainer verdict 'right idea, but the fix is in the wrong place ... belongs in LengthOrNumber (or a ToCss derive) so future properties get it automatically.' No maintainer comment on the PR itself; author's comments (2026-11-16) are a description and a CodSpeed runner note. No competing PR.

Thanks for tracking this down, and for the thorough tests! The problem is real: a zero length in a property that also accepts a number has to keep its unit, otherwise `0px` → `40px` stops animating smoothly.

The one thing I'd like changed is where the fix lives. Right now the same hand-written `ToCss` with `with_zero_units` is repeated in `LengthOrNumber`, `BorderImageSideWidth` and `LineHeight`, so the next property with a `<length> | <number>` grammar would hit the same bug. Could this be handled in one place instead? For example, have `BorderImageSideWidth` and `LineHeight` reuse a shared length-or-number type, or let the `ToCss` derive keep the unit for a length variant whenever the enum also has a number variant. Then future properties get this automatically.

The `@property` part and the `in_calc` → `preserve_zero_units` rename look good to keep.
